title: Unseen City Canvases: Exploring Blind and Low Vision People’s Perspectives on Urban and Public Art Accessibility

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative semi-structured interviews using design probes to evaluate AI-generated descriptions of public art, specifically analyzing participant reactions to AI inaccuracies that cause cultural misrepresentation or erasure (e.g., misidentifying an Indigenous canoe as a rocket).

Evaluating the adequacy, safety, and contextual relevance of AI-generated environmental and art descriptions for blind and low vision (BLV) individuals through user studies and interactive AI chats, highlighting systemic gaps in non-visual accessibility.
